critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/audit.py: date filter uses string range on ISO created_at — works for ISO ordering but any created_at written without timezone-normalized format could bypass. Consider indexing on created_at (already declared in server.py) and returning 'has_more' with pagination for cleaner UI.

backend/routers/settings.py: SettingsInput.model_dump() overwrites the whole doc on PUT — a PATCH-style partial-update would be safer so clinical-staff edits (address/phone) don't accidentally clear logo/mailing_address if the form omits any field.

backend/core/audit.py: RETENTION_DAYS is a Python constant; TTL index (expireAfterSeconds) must actually be created on audit_logs.expires_at in server.py startup. Confirmed indexes are declared; ensure test/prod environments actually build the index (verified via GET filter behavior).

backend/routers/forms.py: FORMS_ROLES scope is fine but list_forms allows doctor/nurse/receptionist while create/upload allows the wider FORMS_ROLES set (incl. biller/psych). Verify this asymmetry is intended for the product — currently a biller can CREATE a form but not LIST forms.
